item: The import dialog says what its pause is and is not, in one visible line and a hover, in twelve languages
summary: The line 'Background collection is paused for this whole import' was the only thing said, and the restore's docstring said nothing else writes the live corpus. The line now adds that other background work is not paused and that what it or the person saves while the import runs can be lost, with a hover naming the collection loop and Collect now as paused and the background tasks, Wikipedia updates, other jobs, AI sweeps, start-up upkeep and the person's own changes as not, the carried settings, agenda and interface choices, and the 10-minute wait before the copy (pinned to COLLECTOR_EXIT_WAIT_S). Three keys x12 locales (non-English AI-drafted, native review pending); collection_note, the exclusive docstring and the volume_job comment say the same.
